# Short-form editing

**Turn raw AI clips into clean 9:16 shorts: trims, stitches, grade, loudness, captions and exports — in an editor or with ffmpeg.**

Edits AI-generated clips into publishable 9:16 shorts for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts and X — trimming morph frames, cutting on motion, stitching two generations into one take, speed ramps, J/L cuts, seamless loops, matching colour across models with one warm film grade, two-pass loudness to -14 LUFS, burned-in captions, 1:1 face crops, posters and per-platform export presets. Covers CapCut (2026 US status, commercial-asset licence trap), DaVinci Resolve 20/21 (standard vs Studio) and Premiere 26.3, plus a fully scriptable, tested ffmpeg pipeline. Use when turning generated video into a finished short, when automating edits in an agent, or when exports get rejected, crushed or out of sync.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 20–40 min per short (editor) · 2 min (scripted) | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Review every clip at quarter speed
2. Conform every clip to one master format
3. Cut to the rhythm of short-form
4. Stitch two generations into one continuous take
5. Speed ramps, J-cuts and L-cuts
6. Match colour across models, then grade once
7. Sound, then loudness
8. Captions
9. Export the deliverables
10. Label and hand off

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/short-form-editing.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/short-form-editing.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/short-form-editing.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/short-form-editing.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill short-form-editing`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `short-form-editing.zip` (don't unzip it).
